prompt: Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. Use Spectrum 1-9: page #FBFAF9, text #2D2D1F, accent #42861D, secondary surface #E7EEEF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Use body 20px, heading 28px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
